name: Renegade Fortress
title: Renegade Fortress
summary: The huge fortress the Renegade Lugians and Tumeroks built north of the Valley of Death. In the kit, a curtain wall with a domed gate arch (0x010021D9, 20 m) and two 20 m towers stands on a shelf (z 32). Inside, a courtyard sinks to z 0, ringed by 90 m earth walls that carry two 59 m stone pyramids (0x01001F26). The courtyard holds pitched-roof houses, a 21 m lion-head shrine (0x010026FC), glowing blue columns and cattle pens. The walls are lined with burning-liquid and caltrop spawns, matching acpedia's hot liquid poured by the Gotrok Fortress Guards. The Vale of Giant Flowers covers the slopes outside.

shots.standingOrder: Look up at the domed gate arch of the Renegade Fortress from 34 m north, lens 2 m above the shelf, creeping 1.5 m closer while burning liquid pours from the walls; keep 6 m from the caltrops.
shots.notes: Low angle on the gate: the lens is 0.7-0.9 m above the shelf, 34 m north of the domed gate arch, and looks up 18 deg at it, creeping 1.5 m. Spawns of burning liquid (the hot liquid the Gotrok guards pour on attackers) and caltrops line the wall. The low west sun side-lights the arch. shots.standingOrder: Rise from the shelf north of the fortress gate over its domed arch to reveal the sunken courtyard, the lion head and the two pyramids on the 90 m walls; stay 20 m above the arch.
shots.notes: Signature reveal: the lens starts 3 m above the shelf, 64 m north of the fortress's domed gate arch (20 m), which hides the sunken courtyard. It rises 36 m and pitches down to -16 deg, clearing the arch by 30 m. Beyond it appear the courtyard sunk 30 m below the gate shelf, the houses, the 21 m lion-head shrine and the two 59 m stone pyramids standing on the 90 m earth walls. LOS is clear from about t 5.5 s. The low west sun is on the right.
